preconditions.description: The number of stations n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of commuters m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The total units of Nitro K must be between 0 and 10,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 < d <= 100 for d in distances)
preconditions.description: Each distance between stations must be between 1 and 100 meters.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t <= 10000000 for t, s, e in commuters)
preconditions.description: Each commuter's arrival time t must be between 0 and 10,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s < e <= n for t, s, e in commuters)
preconditions.description: Each commuter's boarding station s and destination station e must be valid and s must be less than e.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal total travel time for all commuters.
